units.source_text: 另外，第一盘是日本棋院同棋正社在大正十五年举行的对抗赛，双方的统帅—名人和雁金七段率先上阵交锋，鏖战两个月。

en.t: Moreover, the first game was part of a match held in Taisho 15 between the Nihon Ki-in and the Kiseisha; the leaders of the two sides, the Meijin and Karigane 7-dan, met first on the board and fought for two months.

units.source_text: 这期间日本棋院也好，棋正社也罢，他们肯定都积极研究过这盘棋，但是有没有给自己一方的统帅提供意见，我就不得而知了。

en.t: During that time, both the Nihon Ki-in and the Kiseisha must certainly have studied the game closely, but whether they offered advice to the leader on their own side, I cannot say.

units.source_text: 我想大概是没有人从旁当参谋吧。

en.t: I suppose probably no one served as an adviser from the sidelines.

units.source_text: 从名人的为人来看，他自己不谋求这种事，也不会让旁人进言。

en.t: Judging from the Meijin's character, he would not seek such a thing himself, nor would he allow others to offer suggestions.
There was nothing to criticize in the Meijin's style of play.
